title: The Giving Tree
author: Shel Silverstein

hero.name: The Giving Tree
hero.description: A large green apple tree with a face, the central character of the book — the tree is the hero students will recognise from the cover
hero.source_note: The Giving Tree is a distinctive illustrated character with a face; source from Creative Fabrica or TPT clip art matching Shel Silverstein style

notes: The Giving Tree by Shel Silverstein follows a boy and a tree across a lifetime. Key vocabulary reflects the objects the tree gives (apples, branches for a house, trunk for a boat) and the emotional arc (happy, give). The tree itself is the hero and needs custom sourcing as its illustrated face is distinctive. 'Old' is included because the passage of time and the boy ageing is central to the story. 'Money' is included because the boy sells apples for money in middle story stages. All 11 fringe words are concrete and picturable.
